deepDiveBlocks.heading: NHS Pharmacy Clinical Pathways
paragraphs: NHS pharmacy clinical services follow commissioned specifications and PGDs where applicable — offering convenient access for selected conditions.
Pharmacists assess whether your symptoms fall within pharmacy scope, provide supply or advice where eligible, and refer clearly when GP or urgent care is more appropriate.
bulletTopics: GP, NHS 111 or A&E referral when needed

preparationGuide: Blood pressure readings if you monitor at home
comparisonPoints: Pharmacy access can reduce GP waiting times for suitable minor illness
Red-flag symptoms still require GP or urgent care — not pharmacy treatment
NHS eligibility and commissioning vary by location and presentation
